high_level_description: This image depicts a car being worked on in what appears to be a garage or workshop. The car is elevated on a yellow hydraulic lift, which is labeled "Dannmar MX6" on the side, indicating the brand of the lift. The car itself is black and has its doors removed, exposing the interior and some of the internal components. The front wheel is still attached, and the tire appears to be a spare or a temporary one, as it does not match the car's original design. The floor of the garage is covered with a large white tarp to protect it from any spills or debris that might result from the work
